s1loc: Bootle's events scene has grown up around its canal-side waterfront. Salt and Tar runs free Street Food Socials and a calendar of ticketed gigs and comedy, and its summer Music Weekender has drawn headline names like Tom Jones, Status Quo, Sugababes and Billy Ocean to the dockside. The Bootle International Festival brings a day of world music, dance and food to the same canalside, while Lock and Quay anchors the grassroots live scene a short walk along the water.

Maidenhead runs much of its programme by the Thames.
